title: Ijwi Ryarwanya Ingoma y’Ikigirwamana
intro: Mu ntumwa z’Ishobora vyose harimwo umusuku ashikamye yahagurukiye mw’ihanga ry’intabarirwa kugira ngo ashikirize ukuri. Abantu babo bari barafashe ubumana bw’ibinyoma, bagaheba Umuremyi w’ibiriho vyose. Uwo muntu afise umwiyemezo udatezuka, yarabahamagara — ariko ubutumwa bwashikiwe n’uguhakana no kwanka. Intambwe mu bimenyetso kugira ngo umenye uwo musuku yitayeho yari nde.
clues: Narungitswe nk’intumwa ku bantu b’inkozi z’ikibi bari barazimiye kure y’inzira igororotse.
Naje kwibutsa ihanga ryanje Uwaremye ibiriho vyose — ari we mwiza kuruta abaremyi bose.
Abantu banje bari bahindukiriye ikigirwamana c’ikinyoma basenga, bagahamagara amanywa n’ijoro.
Narabarwanya n’ubushizi bw’amanga, ndababaza igituma bosenga imana y’ibinyoma maze bagaheba Umukama wabo w’ukuri.
Baranyihakanye, banka kwumviriza, bafatanya n’ikinyoma cabo — yamara Umukama wanje yaranzigamye.
Ndi Ilyas — amahoro arampa, naharurwa mu basuku b’Ikigongwe b’abizera.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Guhamagara abantu ngo bave mu gusenga Bayali .
Guhangana n’umunyagitugu yivugira ko ari imana .
Kugabisha abantu ku bijanye n'umwuzure uriko uraza
Kurongora urugendo rwo kuva mu gihugu c'ubuja .
trial.answer: Guhamagara abantu ngo bave mu gusenga Bayali .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yahawe amahoro kandi aharurwa mu basuku batoranijwe ba Allah .
Yarongowe mw'iparadizo mu gihe abandi bose bariko baratikizwa .
Yarokowe mu muriro munini wacitse uwukonje kandi utekanye .
Hatanzwe ububasha ku ma jinn, ku bantu no ku muyaga
Umubiri warazigamye nk'ikimenyetso kiramvye c'imyaka yose
outcome.answer: Yahawe amahoro kandi aharurwa mu basuku batoranijwe ba Allah .
